name: Yasuaki Shimizu

sonic_profile.texture: layered, cycling — saxophone, marimba, percussion interlocking in loops; the texture is the composition
sonic_profile.density: medium — intricate but not cluttered; fast and slow passages offset each other
sonic_profile.energy: exploratory, restless, playful — 'equal parts intense and playful, sophisticated and fun'

philosophical_profile: Shimizu approaches texture as primary material rather than carrier for melody. The saxophone isn't leading a band — it's one element in an orchestrated cycle where repetition and layering create meditative quality through movement rather than stillness. Less interested in quiet than in pattern. His cyclical loops feel environmental not because they recede, but because they become the room. Cross-genre by disposition — jazz vocabulary in an ambient structure, dub space in a jazz body.

sources.summary: In Sheep's Clothing review of Kakashi — description of layered/cyclical approach, jazz-ambient-dub fusion.
